findings.title: Preserve local-only named checkpoint loading
findings.description: For a local named Llama checkpoint and a local tokenizer, the new unconditional prepare_model_init_context call enters model_init.py:83-85 and constructs model.hf_checkpoint_converter() before replacing its tokenizer. LlamaConfig.hf_checkpoint_converter() uses the default NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf reference when model.tokenizer is unset; HFCheckpointConverter.__init__ eagerly resolves that reference tokenizer through AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained. The former local checkpoint branch constructed only the model template and checkpoint loader, so it worked without that unrelated HF cache or network access. A cold offline environment, or an unavailable reference, now prevents an otherwise entirely local sampling run.
findings.requested_change: Create the checkpoint initialization context without resolving an HF converter, or make the shared initialization path bind the already-loaded tokenizer before eager converter construction. Retain shared load_model_from_source loading. Fresh targeted review is required after the fix and before commit.

resolved_findings.source: sample_lm.py:74-83 prepares the existing HF context only when hf_ref is present; local checkpoint sampling creates the existing ModelInitContext with configured model, converter=None, and use_hf_model_config=False. Both named and native checkpoint branches of load_model_from_source use no converter. Therefore the local path never resolves the model reference tokenizer.
resolved_findings.test: test_native_generation.py:398-401 sets tokenizer=None and a nonexistent absolute model reference on the named local checkpoint configuration after checkpoint creation. The real load/precision and main generation tests then use the outer local tokenizer and assert full weights/logits or independently computed greedy tokens/logprobs. Reintroducing unconditional context preparation resolves the missing reference and fails, so this exercises R1 through actual behavior without mocking internals or asserting helper dispatch.
resolved_findings.docs: inference.md:142-143 documents the preserved local-only contract.
resolved_findings.hf_semantics: The HF branch retains prepare_model_init_context with tokenizer, initialize_from_hf=hf_ref and use_hf_model_config=True; shared named/native source loader arguments and source architecture resolution are unchanged from the first reviewed extraction.
